text_block_list.name: Letter from Former H...
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Nakayama Festa, It has been quite a 
while since the violets were in bloom."

text_block_list.name: Letter from Former H...
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations on winning the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe."

text_block_list.name: Japanese Fan
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, that's insane!! Nakayama Festa 
actually pulled it off!!

text_block_list.name: Japanese Fan
text_block_list.text:
Japanese Umamusume really can... take on 
the world after all!!

text_block_list.name: Letter from Former H...
text_block_list.text:
"You made the dream of every person in 
Japan come true.
You set the hearts of all 
who dream in motion."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(My heart is still pounding like crazy... 
Can't blame it, though. Not after a race 
that intense.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Letter from Former H...
text_block_list.text:
"As I mentioned before... The desire to 
see the results is otherwise known as 
hope."

text_block_list.name: Letter from Former H...
text_block_list.text:
"You showed me what lies beyond hope—
how a 
dream truly breathes life."

text_block_list.name: Letter from Former H...
text_block_list.text:
"...I am actually writing this text right 
now, the day before the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe, in the airport lobby."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Ho...
text_block_list.text: I'm really here...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Sensei!? Wh-Why are you here?!
You got 
permission from the doctor, right?!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You're an accomplice too, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Letter from Former H...
text_block_list.text:
"If we leave now, we'll just barely make 
it in time for the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe. That battle of words with the 
doctor was worth it."

text_block_list.name: Letter from Former H...
text_block_list.text:
"After writing all that, it might sound 
odd, but I still don't know who will
claim 
victory. Even so, I have made up my mind."

text_block_list.name: Letter from Former H...
text_block_list.text: "I will wager my everything on you."

text_block_list.name: Letter from Former H...
text_block_list.text:
"I am writing this letter with the 
intention of handing it to you once you 
have won the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
In fact, I have already informed your 
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I thought you said you couldn't make it. 
Why the sudden change of plans...?
choice_data_list: She said she has something she wan...

text_block_list.name: Letter from Former H...
text_block_list.text:
"I spoke with Trainer on the phone and 
said this would be our final bet. A small 
prayer from all of us cheering you on."
choice_data_list: They said they have something to g...

text_block_list.name: Letter from Former H...
text_block_list.text:
"A very tiny, final move. With this, both 
Trainer and I are going all-in."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Ho...
text_block_list.text:
Um, the letter is... Ah, here it is! 
Trainer, on three! Ready...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Ho...
text_block_list.text: "The winner is—"

text_block_list.name: Letter from Former H...
text_block_list.text:
"Let me write it down once more. Nakayama 
Festa, congratulations on your victory. 
This is our gamble, and our prayer."

text_block_list.name: Letter from Former H...
text_block_list.text:
"Sincerely, From someone kept alive by 
hope."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Well... that's what matters most.
